This is a fork of [stefansundin/bluesnooze](https://github.com/stefansundin/bluesnooze). It manages Bluetooth and Wi-Fi around sleep and unlock, and requires macOS 26.0 or later.

## Install

1. Download the zip below, unzip it, and move `Bluesnooze.app` to your Applications folder.
2. The app is not notarised. On the first launch macOS blocks it. Open System Settings, go to Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway, authenticate, then click Open.
3. Allow Bluetooth when macOS asks.
4. Optional: enable Launch at login from the menu.

Each release is ad-hoc signed, so macOS treats an update as a different app. After replacing the app, allow Bluetooth again in System Settings, Privacy & Security, Bluetooth, and re-enable Launch at login if you use it.

The attached `.sha256` file contains the checksum for the zip.
